headline: CADE Approves Merger of Arezzo and SOMA to Form Azzas 2154
summary: Brazil's antitrust regulator, CADE, has approved the merger between retailers Arezzo and SOMA without restrictions. The combined entity will operate under the name Azzas 2154.
why: Arezzo and SOMA are major players in the Brazilian fashion retail sector. The merger creates a significant consolidated entity in the apparel market.

impacts.name: Azzas 2154
impacts.why: The approval of the merger allows the companies to integrate operations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory approval removes a key uncertainty for the merger, allowing the companies to proceed with integration.
